no_adcom_quote.quote: A Pulmonary Allergy Drug Advisory Committee (PADAC) meeting was neither convened nor required for this submission as the safety and efficacy of an anticholinergic such as REV in the treatment of COPD is well-described and well-understood.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for the YUPELRI (revefenacin) NDA210598. The Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, and Medical Review all state that a Pulmonary Allergy Drug Advisory Committee (PADAC) meeting was neither convened nor required, because the safety and efficacy of an anticholinergic for COPD is well-described and well-understood. Because no committee met, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
